﴿فليمدد بسبب إلى السماء ثم ليقطع فلينظر هل يذهبن كيده ما يغيظ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the lām is the lām of command; يمدد: imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the lām of command, its fāʿil (agent) latent, its implied form being هو; بسبب: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يمدد﴾; إلى السماء: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of سبب. ﴿ثم ليقطع﴾: conjoined to فليمدد; ﴿هل﴾: an interrogative particle; يذهبن: imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa; كيده: fāʿil; ﴿ما﴾: the object of يذهبن; the clause ﴿يغيظ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿هل يذهبن﴾ is in the place of accusative by ﴿ينظر﴾.

muyesser-irab:16-16.t:
﴿وكذلك أنزلناه آيات بينات﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (mithl), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e.: "and with the like of that wondrous sending-down did We send it down"; ﴿ذلك﴾: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; ﴿أنزلناه﴾: verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); آيات: a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ in أنزلناه; بينات: a naʿt.
﴿وأن الله يهدي من يريد﴾: the wāw conjoins to the hāʾ of أنزلناه, the meaning being: "We sent down that Allah guides whomever He wills to guide". Or the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and أنّ and what lies within its scope are in the position of nominative for an implied (muḍmar) mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: "and the matter is that Allah guides whom He wills". أن الله: أنّ is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the word of majesty (Allah) is its noun (ism); the clause ﴿يهدي﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of أن; مَن: the object of يهدي; the clause ﴿يريد﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿من﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:17-17.t:
﴿إن الذين آمنوا والذين هادوا والصابئين والنصارى والمجوس والذين أشركوا إن الله يفصل بينهم يوم القيامة﴾: إن الذين: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and الذين is its noun (ism); the clause آمنوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; what follows is conjoined to الذين; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya); the second إن with its noun and its khabar (predicate), ﴿إن الله يفصل ...﴾, is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the first إن. The clause ﴿يفصل بينهم﴾ is the khabar of the second إن; بينهم: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يفصل﴾; يوم: an adverb attached to ﴿يفصل﴾; القيامة: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿إن الله على كل شيء شهيد﴾: إن is an abrogating particle, and the word of majesty (Allah) is its noun; على كل شيء: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to شهيد; شهيد: the khabar of إن; the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya).

muyesser-irab:18-18.t:
﴿ألم تر أن الله يسجد له من في السماوات ومن في الأرض والشمس والقمر والنجوم والجبال والشجر والدواب وكثير من الناس وكثير حق عليه العذاب﴾: the hamza is for interrogation; لم is a particle of negation, of conversion (to the past) and of the jussive; تر: imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being أنت; the "seeing" here is of knowledge (ʿilmiyya); أن الله: أنّ is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the word of majesty (Allah) is its noun (ism); the clause ﴿يسجد له﴾ is its khabar (predicate); ﴿له﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يسجد﴾; مَن: fāʿil; ﴿في السماوات﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative, the ṣila clause having no grammatical position; مَن: conjoined to the first ﴿من﴾; ﴿في الأرض﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila of the relative, the ṣila clause having no grammatical position; ﴿الشمس والقمر والنجوم والجبال والشجر والدواب وكثير من الناس﴾ are conjoined items; من الناس: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of كثير; أنّ and what lies within its scope fill the place of the two objects of تر.
﴿وكثير حق عليه العذاب﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿كثير﴾: conjoined; the clause ﴿حق عليه العذاب﴾ is a naʿt of ﴿كثير﴾; or ﴿كثير﴾ is mubtadaʾ (subject) and the clause ﴿حق عليه العذاب﴾ is the khabar, and the clause is conjoined to what precedes.
﴿ومن يهن الله فما له من مكرم﴾: the wāw is resumptive or a conjunction; مَن is conditional, in the position of accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿يهن﴾; the word of majesty is the fāʿil; ما is negating; ﴿له﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; مِن is a redundant (ṣila) preposition; مكرم: genitive in form by مِن, a mubtadaʾ nominative in position; the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position, or conjoined.
﴿إن الله يفعل ما يشاء﴾: إن is an abrogating particle, and the word of majesty is its noun; the clause يفعل is its khabar; the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya).

muyesser-irab:19-19.t:
﴿هذان خصمان اختصموا في ربهم﴾: the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position; هذان: mubtadaʾ (subject); خصمان: its khabar (predicate); the clause اختصموا is a naʿt (adjective) of خصمان. Or خصمان is a badal (substitute) from هذان and the clause اختصموا is the khabar; في ربهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿اختصموا﴾.
﴿فالذين كفروا قطعت لهم ثياب من نار يصب من فوق رءوسهم الحميم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; الذين: mubtadaʾ; the clause كفروا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; the clause قطعت is the khabar; ﴿لهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿قطعت﴾; ثياب: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); ﴿من نار﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt of ثياب; the clause يصب is a second khabar of the relative noun, or a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause from the pronoun in ﴿لهم﴾, or resumptive with no grammatical position; يصب: an imperfect verb in the passive (built for that whose agent is not named); من فوق رءوسهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يصب﴾; الحميم: nāʾib fāʿil.

muyesser-irab:20-20.t: ﴿يصهر به ما في بطونهم والجلود﴾: يصهر: an imperfect verb in the passive (built for that whose agent is not named); به: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يصهر﴾; ما: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); في بطونهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, the ṣila clause having no grammatical position; الجلود: conjoined to ما; the clause ﴿يصهر﴾ is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from الحميم.

muyesser-irab:21-21.t: ﴿ولهم مقامع من حديد﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿لهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); مقامع: the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); من حديد: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of مقامع.

muyesser-irab:22-22.t:
﴿كلما أرادوا أن يخرجوا منها من غم أعيدوا فيها﴾: ﴿كلما﴾: ﴿كلَّ﴾ stands in for an adverb of time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أعيدوا﴾ and containing the meaning of condition; ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya of time (maṣdariyya zamāniyya); the clause ﴿أرادوا﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of the particle-relative ﴿ما﴾; ﴿ما﴾ with what it governs is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), genitive by annexation, the implied form being: "every willing", with an omitted muḍāf implied, i.e.: "every time of their willing to go out". Or ﴿ما﴾ is an indefinite described noun (nakira mawṣūfa) meaning ﴿وقت﴾ ("time"), with the referent pronoun omitted, the implied form being: "every time in which they wanted to go out", so that the clause ﴿أرادوا﴾ is in the position of genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿ما﴾. ﴿أرادوا﴾: verb and fāʿil (agent); the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن يخرجوا﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿أرادوا﴾; ﴿منها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يخرجوا﴾; ﴿من غم﴾: a badal ishtimāl (substitute of inclusion) from the preposition and genitive noun before it, because it includes it. The clause ﴿أعيدوا﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the answer of ﴿كلما﴾; فيها: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أعيدوا﴾.
﴿وذوقوا عذاب الحريق﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and the conjoined element is omitted, its implied form being: "and it will be said to them"; the clause ﴿ذوقوا عذاب الحريق﴾ is the speech (maqūl) of the omitted saying; ذوقوا: verb and fāʿil; عذاب: mafʿūl bihi; الحريق: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:23-23.t:
﴿إن الله يدخل الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات جنات تجري من تحتها الأنهار﴾: the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position. إن الله: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the word of majesty (Allah) is its noun (ism); the clause ﴿يدخل﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of إن; الذين: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿آمنوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative, with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿عملوا الصالحات﴾ is conjoined to آمنوا; جنات: second mafʿūl bihi by extension (ʿalā al-saʿa), or accusative by removal of the preposition; the clause ﴿تجري من تحتها النهار﴾ [Translator's note: so written in the source; the Quranic text is تجري من تحتها الأنهار] is a naʿt (adjective) of جنات.
﴿يحلون فيها من أساور من ذهب ولؤلؤا﴾: يحلون: an imperfect verb in the passive (built for that whose agent is not named), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); فيها: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يحلون﴾; من أساور: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a naʿt of an omitted object, i.e.: "they are adorned with ornaments of bracelets"; من ذهب: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt of أساور; the clause ﴿يحلون﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from الذين; ﴿لؤلؤًا﴾: conjoined to the position of ﴿من أساور﴾, because its position is accusative; and it was said: accusative by an omitted verb, its implied form being: "and they are given pearls".
﴿ولباسهم فيها حرير﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لباسهم: mubtadaʾ (subject); فيها: ḥāl; حرير: khabar.

muyesser-irab:24-24.t:
﴿وهدوا إلى الطيب من القول﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; هدوا: a past verb in the passive (built for that whose agent is not named), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); ﴿إلى الطيب﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿هدوا﴾; من القول: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun latent in الطيب.
﴿وهدوا إلى صراط الحميد﴾: conjoined to the preceding clause; هدوا: a past verb in the passive, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil; إلى صراط: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿هدوا﴾; الحميد: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:25-25.t:
﴿إن الذين كفروا ويصدون عن سبيل الله والمسجد الحرام الذي جعلناه للناس سواء العاكف فيه والباد﴾: the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position; إن الذين: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and الذين is a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as the noun (ism) of إن; the clause كفروا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; ويصدون: the wāw is a conjunction, and يصدون is conjoined to كفروا; عن سبيل الله: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يصدون﴾; ﴿المسجد الحرام﴾: conjoined to ﴿سبيل الله﴾; الذي: a second naʿt (adjective) of المسجد; the clause جعلناه is the ṣila of الذي, with no grammatical position; جعلناه: verb and fāʿil (agent), and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); للناس: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was a naʿt and was placed first; سواء: the second object of ﴿جعلناه﴾ if جعل takes two objects; if it takes one object, سواء is parsed as a ḥāl from the hāʾ of جعلناه; العاكف: the fāʿil of سواء, because it is a maṣdar (verbal noun) used as a description and so has the force of the derived active participle, i.e.: "We made it such that the resident in it is equal… etc." ﴿الباد﴾, with the yāʾ omitted following the script of the Muṣḥaf, is conjoined to العاكف; the khabar (predicate) of إن is omitted, its implied form being "they have lost" or "they have perished" or the like.
﴿ومن يرد فيه بإلحاد بظلم نذقه من عذاب أليم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿مَن﴾: a conditional noun causing the jussive, mubtadaʾ (subject); يرد: the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); فيه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يرد﴾; the object of يرد is omitted so as to cover everything it could cover; بإلحاد: ḥāl; بظلم: also a ḥāl; نذقه: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), its fāʿil latent (mustatir), its implied form being نحن, and the hāʾ in ﴿نذقه﴾ is mafʿūl bihi; من عذاب: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿نذقه﴾; أليم: a naʿt.

muyesser-irab:26-26.t:
﴿وإذ بوأنا لإبراهيم مكان البيت أن لا تشرك بي شيئا﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; إذ: a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, the implied form being: "and remember when We settled"; the clause ﴿بوأنا﴾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); بوأنا: verb and fāʿil (agent); ﴿لإبراهيم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿بوأنا﴾; مكان البيت: the object of بوأنا; ﴿أن﴾ is explicative (tafsīriyya), because it occurs after an implied saying, i.e.: "saying to him: Do not associate"; the clause after it is explicative with no grammatical position. لا is prohibitive (nāhiya); تشرك: imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive lā; ﴿بي﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تشرك﴾; شيئًا: the object of تشرك.
﴿وطهر بيتي للطائفين والقائمين والركع السجود﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; طهر: imperative verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir), its implied form being أنت; بيتي: the object of طهر; للطائفين: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿طهر﴾; القائمين and الركع are conjoined to what precedes; ﴿السجود﴾: a badal (substitute) from ﴿الركع﴾, genitive like it.

muyesser-irab:27-27.t: ﴿وأذن في الناس بالحج يأتوك رجالا وعلى كل ضامر يأتين من كل فج عميق﴾: أذن: imperative verb; في الناس: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أذن﴾; بالحج: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e.: "proclaiming"; يأتوك: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it occurs as the answer to the request; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). رجالا: ḥāl; ﴿على كل ضامر﴾ is conjoined to رجالا, i.e.: "they will come to you on foot and riding". ﴿يأتين﴾: an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn because it is joined to the nūn of the feminine plural, and the nūn is the fāʿil; the clause يأتين is a naʿt (adjective) of كل ضامر; ﴿من كل فج﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يأتين﴾; عميق: a naʿt of ﴿فج﴾.

muyesser-irab:28-28.t:
﴿ليشهدوا منافع لهم ويذكروا اسم الله في أيام معلومات على ما رزقهم من بهيمة الأنعام﴾: the lām is causal (taʿlīl); يشهدوا: an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (muḍmara) أن after it; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from the implied ﴿أن﴾ and the verb after it is genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يأتوك﴾; منافع: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿لهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of منافع; يذكروا: conjoined to يشهدوا, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿اسم﴾: mafʿūl bihi; في أيام: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يذكروا﴾; معلومات: a naʿt of أيام; ﴿على ما رزقهم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are also attached to ﴿يذكروا﴾; ﴿من بهيمة الأنعام﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿رزقهم﴾.
﴿فكلوا منها وأطعموا البائس الفقير﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the "eloquent" fāʾ, implying an omitted condition); كلوا: imperative verb and fāʿil; منها: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿كلوا﴾; أطعموا: conjoined to كلوا; البائس: mafʿūl bihi; الفقير: a naʿt.
